'''Twin Shadows Inn''' was a cafe and inn in [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]]. Following their marriage, the rural shop owner [[Dannar Calwell]] treated his newly-wed wife [[Annileen Calwell]] for a meal to celebrate their honeymoon. In her recollections, Annileen regarded the Twin Shadows Inn as an "acceptably clean" but not posh establishment in the upmarket [[Kerner Plaza]].<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
